narrative: Day 3 is a cold, clear Friday and the first working day after the Kick-off Meeting. All HELIOS work is still office-based in Tashkent; the Qizilqum site has no presence yet. Helios EPC puts its main planning and engineering baselines on paper: the Level 1 and Level 2 Milestone Schedule and the Engineering Execution Plan with its deliverables list. On the commercial side, the team follows up on the KOM actions for the APG, the Performance Security and authorised signatories, which are needed before NTP on 15 December.
